result:
Fixed in `anthrouter/pace.py`. `period_workday_dates` treated `period_end` (the first instant of the next month) as an inclusive date. For UTC, that counted Oct 1, 2026 (a Thursday) as a September workday, which gave 23 instead of 22. It now uses the last instant before `period_end`.

The 61 pace and oauth_usage tests pass. I didn't check the September 2026 count directly. The full suite was still running in the background when I stopped, so I haven't seen its result.
